messages.subject: Ipsative modeling
parts:
Hi Phil,

The ipsative modeling known in IRT framework is http://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/22733226. I think mirt is capable of this model for limited number of pairwise comparison items because of the demanding multivariate normal integral. It may require user-defined probability function via createItem() to compute the integral . But the user-defined probability function only allows for single item's parameters, my question is how to send (1) the all present estimates of all items  and (2) the item indexing of present evaluated to user-defined probability function?  Or declaring global variables is also fine. Thanks!

Keith

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Ipsative modeling
parts:
Hi Keith,

Seems like an interesting idea, though I'm not overly familiar with ipsative models. I'll have to learn more about them at some time in the future before I can make any real recommendations for tackling them. Thanks for the reference though. Cheers.

Phil
